title: Bind Tau TUI voice events to Chatterbox /tau/voice-render and real turn controls
chatterbox_service: live on :8018 (uvicorn chatterbox.agent.server:app; /health ok/live/model_loaded/cuda); implements /tau/voice-render + turn/playback controls (server.py:2128,2301,2306).

proven_live.contract_and_failure_tests: request schema/hashes/run-turn lineage/delivery deterministic; missing config -> one explicit degraded receipt; approve/authorized/yes cannot satisfy a gate (tests/test_tui_voice.py: 6 passed).
proven_live.live_item_1_routine_turbo: routine progress render -> engine=chatterbox_turbo, ok/live=true, mocked=false.
proven_live.live_item_2_blocker_approval_via_voice_r: blocker+approval-wait rendered through /tau/voice-render with lineage/delivery metadata; failed_gates=[].
proven_live.live_item_3_weighted_base: weighted request (intensity 0.55, valence -0.20) -> engine=chatterbox_base, ok=true, mocked=false.
proven_live.end_to_end_receipt: mocked:false live:true binding with audio identity (finished_response_audio, answer_text_sha256). See live-engine-selection-and-audio-identity.json + live-tau-voice-render-proof.json.
proven_live.approval_boundary: voice never satisfies approval/repair/release; spoken approval refused.

deferred_not_proven: live item 4 tail: 'no later PCM accepted for a cancelled turn' (control accepted; post-cancel audio rejection not asserted).
live item 5: stale-turn supersession cannot resume.
live item 6: audio playback through the documented local path retained.
live items 7/8: stop/restart Chatterbox resilience — requires bouncing the shared :8018 service, not done unilaterally.
proves: Tau projects authoritative run/turn state into the real Chatterbox /tau/voice-render contract with live non-mocked synthesis, correct turbo-vs-base model selection on weighted affect, real turn controls, an end-to-end audio-identity receipt, and a preserved refuse-approval boundary — the real-service integration #158 explicitly excluded.
does_not_prove: Stale-turn supersession, local audio playback retention, and stop/restart resilience (deferred list above); perceptual emotion calibration (tracked separately).
